product.title: Moab's #1 Rated Guided U-Drive Hell's Revenge Off-Road Tour

description.text: Join this group adventure that takes you along Moab's legendary Hell's Revenge trail by UTV. Drive your own vehicle, wearing your provided helmet and goggles for safety, and follow your guide through exhilarating rock climbs and stunning desert scenery. Stops include Hell's Revenge. Transportation, safety gear, and local commentary are handled so you can focus on the red rock landscape. Ideal for travelers basing in Moab who want a guided Utah adventure without self-driving backcountry roads or river put-ins.
